host_path_before_values.rule: `before` values restore v3 bytes and may carry the source's host-path strings; they are lineage, never resolved.

rule: Applying the deltas of a file to its placed bytes gives back its v3 source member: structurally (parsed JSON equal with key order, or Markdown text equal) and byte-for-byte when the JSON is re-serialized with source_json_format. Deltas describe the forward change v3 -> placed; the inverse restores `before`.
serialization: UTF-8 JSON, indent 2, trailing LF. The members of this file are written with sorted keys; each delta's `before` and `after` value keeps the object key order of the document it comes from (the v3 source member or the placed file), because that order is part of what the inverse restores. Read it with an order-preserving JSON parser.

source_edition.note: source_member paths are members of this external edition; they are lineage coordinates, never resolved against the repository.
